A '''Human female''' with a heart-shaped [[Hair/Legends|hairdo]] was a member of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council/Legends|Royal Advisory Council]] around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], under the rule of [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]]. Like other members of the Council, she held a ministerial office, and her role was to advise the Queen on matters that fell within her purview.<ref name="E1:IG" /> She was in the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]] during a meeting between [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Queen Amidala]] and the Council immediately prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The unidentified councilwoman appeared as a background character in the [[1999]] movie [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], first installment of the ''Star Wars'' [[prequel trilogy]]. A brief, non-speaking role, she was played by an unknown extra. As of [[2013]], she remains one of the two members of the Council seen in ''The Phantom Menace'' that still have no name in [[canon]]. In their only scene, the orange-robed councilor and her [[Unidentified Naboo councilman|bearded colleague]] were standing in the room, while their peers were seating around Queen Amidala.<ref name="TPM" />
